question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He saw a snake freezing in the snow. || B. A farmer was walking through his field on a cold winter morning. || C. The snake, out of its natural instinct, bit the farmer. || D. Pitying it, he picked it up and put it in his pocket to warm it.
explanation: Sabse pehle B aayega kyunki yeh main character (farmer) aur story ka setting introduce kar raha hai. Uske baad A aayega jahan usne snake ko dekha. Phir D aayega kyunki 'he' (farmer) ne usko pocket mein rakha. Last mein C aayega jahan snake ne bite kiya, jo story ka end hai.
trick: Pronoun 'He' sentence A aur D mein hai, jo Noun 'farmer' (sentence B) ke liye use hua hai. Toh B hamesha A aur D se pehle aayega.
tip: Noun hamesha pronoun se pehle aata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He looked around and finally saw a pitcher with a little water at the bottom. || B. It was a hot summer day and a crow was very thirsty. || C. The water level rose, and he drank it happily. || D. He picked up small pebbles and dropped them into the pitcher one by one.
explanation: Sentence B introductory hai kyunki yeh batata hai ki crow thirsty tha. Fir A aayega jahan usko pitcher (matka) mila. Uske baad D aayega jahan usne pebbles daale paani upar laane ke liye. C last hoga kyunki paani upar aaya aur usne pee liya.
trick: Sentence C mein 'drank it happily' result hai, jo hamesha last mein aayega. Options mein check karo jiska end C se ho.
tip: Problem aur solution ka logic follow karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Then, I filled out the account opening form and attached my documents. || B. Yesterday, I decided to open a savings account in the nearby bank. || C. Finally, the manager verified my details and gave me a passbook. || D. First, I went to the inquiry counter to ask about the process.
explanation: B start hoga kyunki decision pehle liya gaya. Fir D aayega jahan 'First' likha hai (inquiry counter gaya). Uske baad A aayega jahan form bhara (Then use hua hai). Last mein C aayega jahan passbook mili (Finally use hua hai).
trick: Transition words jaise 'First' (D), 'Then' (A), aur 'Finally' (C) ek perfect sequence (D -> A -> C) banate hain.
tip: Time sequence words par dhyan do.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He placed a huge boulder in the middle of the main road. || B. Once upon a time, a king wanted to test his people. || C. Instead of moving it, everyone just walked around it and complained. || D. Finally, a poor peasant came and pushed the boulder away, finding gold coins underneath.
explanation: B opening sentence hai kyunki yeh king ko introduce kar raha hai. A uske baad aayega jahan king ne test ke liye pathar (boulder) rakha. C logo ka reaction batata hai ki kisine nahi hataya. D conclusion hai jahan peasant ne pathar hataya.
trick: 'Once upon a time' hamesha story ka opening sentence hota hai. Toh answer B se shuru hoga.
tip: Introduction hamesha general statement hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He went to a jewelry store to find something special. || B. Rahul wanted to buy a birthday gift for his mother. || C. After looking at many designs, he finally chose a beautiful silver ring. || D. He asked the shopkeeper to gift-wrap it with a red ribbon.
explanation: B sabse pehle aayega kyunki yeh subject (Rahul) aur purpose (gift) bata raha hai. A mein woh store gaya gift dhundhne. C mein usne ring select ki. D mein usne usko gift-wrap karwaya jo final step hai.
trick: Noun 'Rahul' (B) hai aur baaki sab mein pronoun 'He' hai. Toh fix hai ki B pehla sentence hoga.
tip: Action ka flow start to end track karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. While crossing a bridge over a stream, he looked down into the water. || B. He barked to steal the other bone, dropping his own into the stream. || C. A hungry dog found a juicy bone and carried it in his mouth. || D. He saw his own reflection and thought it was another dog with a bigger bone.
explanation: C main sentence hai jo dog aur bone ko introduce kar raha hai. A mein wo bridge cross karta hai. D mein usko reflection dikhta hai (water mein dekhne ke baad). B mein wo bark karta hai aur bone kho deta hai.
trick: A mein 'looked down into the water' hai aur D mein 'saw his own reflection' hai. Toh pani mein dekhne ke baad hi reflection dikhega (A -> D mandatory pair).
tip: Mandatory pairs dhundhne ki aadat daalo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Next, add tea leaves, sugar, and milk to the boiling water. || B. Let it simmer for a few minutes until it gets a rich brown color. || C. To make a perfect cup of tea, first boil some water in a pan. || D. Finally, strain the tea into a cup and enjoy it hot.
explanation: Yeh ek recipe process hai. C pehla step hai ('first boil some water'). A dusra step hai jisme ingredients add kiye gaye. B mein usko ubalne diya (simmer). D last step hai jahan chai strain karke pi jaati hai.
trick: Process wale questions mein 'first', 'next', aur 'finally' sequence ko easily set kar dete hain (C -> A -> D).
tip: Chronological order wale words ko identify karo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The lion woke up angrily and caught the mouse in his huge paw. || B. One day, a little mouse started playing on a sleeping lion. || C. A few days later, the mouse saved the lion by biting the hunter's net. || D. The mouse begged for forgiveness, and the lion took pity and let him go.
explanation: B start hoga jahan mouse aur sleeping lion ka intro hai. A mein lion jaag gaya aur usko pakad liya. D mein mouse ne maafi maangi aur lion ne chhod diya. C ek naya event hai jo 'A few days later' se shuru hota hai.
trick: 'A few days later' wala sentence (C) hamesha primary event (B, A, D) ke baad hi aayega.
tip: Time markers story ko guide karte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The hare ran very fast and soon left the tortoise far behind. || B. A hare once made fun of a tortoise for being too slow. || C. Confident of winning, the hare took a nap, but the tortoise kept walking and won. || D. The tortoise challenged him to a race, which the hare accepted laughing.
explanation: B pehla sentence hai jahan hare mazak udata hai. D mein tortoise race ke liye challenge karta hai. A mein race start hoti hai aur hare aage nikal jata hai. C mein hare so jata hai aur tortoise jeet jata hai.
trick: Sentence B mein conflict start hota hai. D uska reaction hai. Race shuru hone ke baad hi bhagne ki baat hogi, so D ke baad A aayega.
tip: Cause aur effect ko match karna seekho.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He jumped again and again, but he could not reach them. || B. A hungry fox saw a bunch of ripe grapes hanging from a high vine. || C. His mouth watered, and he jumped to catch the delicious fruits. || D. Finally, he gave up and walked away saying the grapes were sour.
explanation: B introductory sentence hai fox aur grapes ke baare mein. C mein grapes dekh kar fox ke mooh mein pani aaya aur usne jump kiya. A uske continuous effort (jumped again and again) ko batata hai. D conclusion hai jahan woh haar maan leta hai.
trick: C mein pehli baar 'jumped' use hua aur A mein 'jumped again and again'. Toh logic kehta hai ki C pehle aayega aur A baad mein.
tip: Words ke repetition se sequence hint milta hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. We reached the station early and boarded the train on time. || B. My friends and I planned a trip to Goa for our summer vacation. || C. After reaching Goa, we immediately went to the beach to relax. || D. We booked our train tickets and packed our bags a week in advance.
explanation: B plan ke baare mein bata raha hai, toh yeh first hoga. D mein preparation hai (tickets and bags). A mein journey start hoti hai (boarded the train). C destination pahunchne ka sentence hai (reached Goa).
trick: Goa ke trip ka plan (B) sabse pehle banega, aur Goa pahunchna (C) sabse end mein hoga. Options check karo jisme B first aur C last ho.
tip: Chronological order bilkul real-life jaisa hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. I woke up early and ironed my formal clothes. || B. I had an important job interview scheduled for 10 AM. || C. I reached the office at 9:30 AM and waited in the reception area. || D. After a quick breakfast, I booked a cab to the office.
explanation: B event ka context de raha hai (interview). A subah ki shuruaat batata hai (woke up). D mein usne breakfast karke cab book ki. C mein office pahunchne ki baat hai jo last step hai.
trick: Kahin pahunchne (C - reached office) se pehle cab book karni padegi (D). Toh D -> C mandatory pair ban gaya.
tip: Action ke logical sequence ko pakdo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. One friend quickly climbed up a tree to save himself. || B. Two friends were walking through a dense forest. || C. Suddenly, they saw a large bear approaching them. || D. The other friend did not know how to climb, so he lay down on the ground like a dead man.
explanation: B setting introduce karta hai ki do dost forest mein jaa rahe the. C mein achanak se unhone bear dekha. A batata hai ki ek dost ne kya kiya (climbed tree). D dusre dost ka reaction batata hai (lay down).
trick: 'One friend' (A) aur 'The other friend' (D) ek combination banate hain, isliye A hamesha D se just pehle aayega.
tip: Contrasting pairs (One... The other) ko dhundho.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The grasshopper just sang and danced, making fun of the ant's hard work. || B. An ant was working hard to store food for the upcoming winter. || C. When winter arrived, the grasshopper had nothing to eat and starved. || D. The ant, however, rested happily in her warm home with plenty of food.
explanation: B story start karta hai jahan ant mehnat kar rahi hai. A mein grasshopper ant ka mazak udata hai. C mein jab winter aati hai tab grasshopper pareshan hota hai. D batata hai ki ant safe aur happy thi.
trick: 'When winter arrived' (C) ek naya phase hai jo pehle ki mehnat (B, A) ke baad hi aayega. Aur 'however' (D) contrast show karta hai jo end mein fit hota hai.
tip: 'However' wale sentence usually ending mein aate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He opened it and found a driving license and some cash inside. || B. Amit was walking to school when he saw a black wallet on the road. || C. The man thanked Amit and gave him a reward for his honesty. || D. He took the wallet to the nearest police station to return it to its owner.
explanation: B main sentence hai jo character (Amit) aur object (wallet) ko introduce karta hai. A mein usne wallet khola. D mein usne right action liya (police station gaya). C end hai jahan owner ne usko reward diya.
trick: Pronoun 'He' aur 'it' (A aur D mein) directly noun 'Amit' aur 'wallet' (B) ko point kar rahe hain. Isliye B sabse pehle aayega.
tip: Noun wale sentence hamesha starting points hote hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Out of greed, he killed the goose to get all the eggs at once. || B. A farmer had a magical goose that laid one golden egg every day. || C. He became very rich by selling the golden eggs in the market. || D. But when he cut it open, he found nothing and lost his daily income.
explanation: B start karta hai golden goose ke intro se. C mein wo ande bech kar ameer hota hai. A mein uske lalach ki wajah se wo goose ko maar deta hai. D uska consequence hai jahan usko kuch nahi milta.
trick: A mein 'killed the goose' hai aur D mein 'cut it open' hai. Maarne ke baad hi to open karega. Isliye A -> D ek mandatory pair hai.
tip: Actions ka cause aur effect link banaiye.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He sat by the river and started crying over his loss. || B. A poor woodcutter was chopping a tree near a deep river. || C. The God of Water appeared and offered him a golden axe, which he refused. || D. Suddenly, his iron axe slipped from his hands and fell into the water.
explanation: B intro hai (woodcutter cutting tree). D mein accident hota hai (axe giri). A uska reaction hai (rona shuru kiya). C mein uske rone se bhagwan aate hain.
trick: Kulhadi (axe) giregi (D) tabhi wo royega (A). Aur rone par hi God aayenge (C). Sequence D -> A -> C bilkul clear hai.
tip: Events ki natural timeline ko follow karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. I opened my favorite food delivery app on my smartphone. || B. I was feeling very hungry but too tired to cook dinner. || C. After browsing for a while, I ordered a large paneer pizza. || D. The delivery boy arrived in thirty minutes, and I enjoyed my hot meal.
explanation: B problem batata hai (bhukh lagi thi aur thaka hua tha). A uska solution dhundhne ka pehla step hai (app khola). C mein usne khana order kiya. D final step hai jahan khana deliver hua aur usne khaya.
trick: App open karna (A) hamesha order karne (C) se pehle aayega. Aur order karne ke baad hi delivery aayegi (D).
tip: Tech process ko simple real-world step se jodo.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. When I reached the platform, the train was already moving. || B. I packed my luggage in a hurry and left for the railway station. || C. I woke up very late because I forgot to set my alarm. || D. I tried to run and catch it, but the guard blew his whistle and stopped me.
explanation: C root cause hai (der se uthna). B mein wo jaldi me nikalta hai. A mein wo platform par pahunchta hai aur train chal rahi hoti hai. D mein wo bhag kar pakadne ki koshish karta hai par fail hota hai.
trick: Platform pahunchna (A) station nikalne (B) ke baad hi hoga. Aur train catch karne ka attempt (D) tabhi hoga jab train chal rahi ho (A).
tip: Step by step event ki chain identify karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He brought the puppy home and named it Bruno. || B. Rohan visited the local animal shelter to adopt a pet. || C. He instantly fell in love with a small golden retriever puppy. || D. Bruno quickly became Rohan's best friend and followed him everywhere.
explanation: B start karta hai Rohan ke animal shelter jaane se. C mein usko puppy pasand aata hai. A mein wo puppy ko ghar laata hai aur naam Bruno rakhta hai. D conclusion hai ki wo dono best friends ban gaye.
trick: Sentence A mein puppy ka naam 'Bruno' diya gaya hai. Isliye 'Bruno' word use karne wala sentence D hamesha A ke baad aayega.
tip: Naamkaran wale sentence ke baad hi naam use hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He finally spotted a small tea stall at the corner of the street. || B. A tired traveler was looking for a place to rest and have something warm. || C. He ordered a cup of strong tea and sat down on a wooden bench. || D. After walking for three hours in the cold wind, he was completely exhausted.
explanation: Sabse pehle D aayega kyunki yeh traveler ki condition aur reason (walking for 3 hours) batata hai. Uske baad B aayega jo uski need (looking for a place) batata hai. A mein usko tea stall dikhta hai. C mein woh tea order karta hai, jo final action hai.
trick: Sentence D condition set kar raha hai, jiske turant baad B us condition ka effect dikhata hai. 'Exhausted' ke baad hi 'rest' dhundhega.
tip: Cause (exhaustion) aur effect (need rest) ko connect karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Pour the hot water into the cup and stir it well with a spoon. || B. To make instant coffee, first boil a cup of water in a kettle. || C. Your delicious coffee is now ready to be served. || D. Meanwhile, take a coffee mug and add a spoonful of coffee powder and sugar.
explanation: Yeh ek process hai. B pehla step hai jisme pani boil karne ko kaha gaya hai. D mein us waqt (meanwhile) mug mein powder aur sugar daalne ki baat hai. A mein hot water daal kar stir karna hai. C concluding sentence hai ki coffee ready hai.
trick: 'First' word B mein hai, toh wahi se shuru hoga. 'Ready to be served' (C) hamesha end mein aayega.
tip: 'First' aur 'Meanwhile' jaise words sequence banate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Two foolish cats found a piece of bread and started fighting over it. || B. The monkey cleverly ate the entire bread while pretending to divide it equally. || C. A cunning monkey saw them fighting and offered to divide the bread for them. || D. The cats agreed and handed over the bread to the monkey.
explanation: A main sentence hai jo story ke characters (cats) ko introduce karta hai aur conflict (fighting) batata hai. C mein monkey aata hai aur help offer karta hai. D mein cats agree karti hain. B mein monkey unhe bewakoof banata hai (end of story).
trick: Monkey pehle offer karega (C) aur cats usko bread dengi (D). Toh C hamesha D se pehle aayega. C->D ek mandatory pair hai.
tip: Story ka introduction aur conclusion jaldi identify karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He forgot it on the bus and realized it only after reaching school. || B. His mother gave him a new umbrella because it was raining heavily. || C. Rohan was getting ready to go to school on a Monday morning. || D. He felt very sad and decided to apologize to his mother later.
explanation: C starting sentence hai jahan Rohan ka intro hai. B mein mother usko umbrella deti hai. A mein wo umbrella bus mein bhool jata hai. D mein usko bura lagta hai jo uski galti ka reaction hai.
trick: 'It' pronoun A mein umbrella ke liye use hua hai (B). Isliye A hamesha B ke baad hi aayega.
tip: Noun aur Pronoun ka relation sabse important hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. We saw lions, tigers, and a very playful baby elephant. || B. Last Sunday, our school arranged a picnic to the city zoo. || C. Before leaving the zoo, we all had a grand lunch together. || D. As soon as we entered, we bought our tickets from the counter.
explanation: B intro hai jo picnic ke plan ko batata hai. D mein zoo enter karne aur tickets lene ki baat hai. A mein unhone animals dekhe. C last mein aayega kyunki 'Before leaving' likha hai, jo end of trip dikhata hai.
trick: 'Entered' (D) pehle aayega, uske baad hi andar ke animals (A) dekhenge. Aur 'leaving' (C) sabse aakhri step hoga.
tip: Events ke time aur logic ko match karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Birbal calmly drew a longer line next to it without touching the first one. || B. Emperor Akbar drew a line on the floor and asked his courtiers to make it shorter. || C. Akbar was very impressed by Birbal's wisdom and rewarded him. || D. He gave a strict condition that no one was allowed to touch or erase his line.
explanation: B pehla sentence hai jahan Akbar challenge deta hai. D us challenge ki condition hai (without touching). A mein Birbal solution nikalta hai. C mein Akbar khush hokar reward deta hai.
trick: Sentence B aur D ek connection banate hain. B mein line draw hui aur D mein us line ko touch na karne ka rule banaya gaya.
tip: Problem, condition, solution, aur reward ka pattern follow karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Finally, he paid the bill at the counter and took his new device home. || B. He needed it urgently to complete his college project. || C. Rahul's old laptop suddenly stopped working last night. || D. So, he went to the electronics mall to buy a new one the next morning.
explanation: C problem batata hai ki laptop kharab ho gaya. B batata hai ki usko naya kyu chahiye (urgent project). D mein woh mall jata hai naya lene. A aakhri sentence hai jahan woh pay karta hai aur ghar aata hai.
trick: Kharab hona (C) aur urgently chahiye hona (B) ek logical pair hain. D uske baad aayega jahan woh mall gaya.
tip: Reasoning wale words jaise 'So' result dikhate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The police officer chased him through the narrow streets. || B. A thief snatched a woman's gold chain in the crowded market. || C. The woman screamed for help, catching the attention of a nearby patrolling police officer. || D. After a short run, the officer caught the thief and recovered the chain.
explanation: B incident ki shuruaat hai jahan chain snatch hoti hai. C mein woman chillati hai jisse police dekhti hai. A mein police officer thief ka peecha karta hai. D mein thief pakda jata hai, jo climax hai.
trick: Scream karne (C) ke baad hi police ko pata chalega, aur tabhi wo chase (A) shuru karega. C -> A mandatory sequence hai.
tip: Action aur uske turant reaction ko link karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. She carefully wove them together to make a strong and cozy home. || B. A little sparrow decided to build a nest for her upcoming babies. || C. Once the nest was ready, she laid three tiny eggs in it. || D. She flew around the garden collecting dry grass, twigs, and soft leaves.
explanation: B intro hai ki sparrow nest banana chahti hai. D mein wo material collect karti hai (grass, twigs). A mein wo unhe bun kar (wove) nest banati hai. C mein nest ready hone ke baad eggs deti hai.
trick: Material collect karna (D) nest banane (A) se pehle hoga. Aur nest ready hone ke baad (C) ka step last aayega.
tip: Pronoun 'them' (A) twigs aur grass (D) ke liye hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Before dying, he told them that a great treasure was hidden in their farm. || B. An old farmer had three sons who were very lazy and never worked. || C. The sons dug up the entire field but found no gold, only fertile soil. || D. They eventually planted seeds in the dug soil and reaped a rich harvest.
explanation: B intro hai jo farmer aur uske lazy sons ko batata hai. A mein farmer marne se pehle unhe treasure ke baare mein batata hai. C mein sons treasure dhundhne ke liye field dig karte hain. D unka final realization aur result hai.
trick: Farmer ka batana (A) lazyness (B) ke baad ka turning point hai. Field dig karna (C) treasure dhundhne ka attempt hai.
tip: Story ka moral hamesha last mein aata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Next, I placed my clothes neatly inside the suitcase. || B. Finally, I locked the bag and kept it near the door. || C. First, I made a list of all the essential items I would need for the trip. || D. I laid my suitcase on the bed to start packing.
explanation: Yeh packing ka process hai. C pehla step hai (making a list). D doosra step hai jahan bag bed par rakha. A mein kapde suitcase mein rakhe gaye (Next). B aakhri step hai (Finally).
trick: 'First', 'Next', 'Finally' words sidha sequence bata rahe hain. List pehle banegi (C), fir packing hogi (D, A).
tip: Transition words automatically order bata dete hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The old woman blessed him for his kindness and went on her way. || B. He gently held her hand and safely guided her to the other side. || C. An old woman was standing at the edge of a busy road, afraid to cross. || D. A young boy noticed her hesitation and quickly ran to her side.
explanation: C scene set karta hai jahan ek old woman road cross karne se darti hai. D mein ek boy usko dekhta hai aur paas jata hai. B mein wo usko safely cross karwata hai. A mein wo boy ko aashirwad deti hai.
trick: Boy paas aayega (D) tabhi toh haath pakdega (B). D -> B mandatory pair hai.
tip: Logical progression of action ko trace karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The teacher welcomed him warmly and introduced him to the class. || B. It was Aryan's first day at his new high school, and he was very nervous. || C. By the time the bell rang, he had already made two new friends. || D. He hesitantly walked into his classroom and took a seat in the back row.
explanation: B intro hai (Aryan ka first day aur nervousness). D mein wo classroom enter karta hai. A mein teacher usko welcome aur introduce karti hai. C din ka end batata hai (bell rang) jahan wo dost bana chuka hota hai.
trick: Classroom mein entry (D) ke baad hi teacher welcome karegi (A). Isliye D hamesha A se pehle aayega.
tip: Din ki shuruaat se end tak ka flow dekhein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He watched a spider fall down many times while trying to spin its web. || B. King Robert Bruce was hiding in a dark cave after losing a major battle. || C. Inspired by the spider, the king gathered his army and fought again, finally winning. || D. However, the spider did not give up and eventually succeeded in reaching the top.
explanation: B main sentence hai jo King Robert Bruce ki situation batata hai. A mein wo spider ko dekhta hai. D batata hai ki spider bar-bar girne ke baad bhi top par pahunch gayi. C mein king spider se inspire hokar jeet jata hai.
trick: Spider ka fail hona (A) aur fir succeed hona (D) ek logical story arc hai. D ke turant baad king ka inspiration (C) aayega.
tip: Observation (A) ke baad hi realization (C) hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Then, place some sliced tomatoes and cucumbers over the butter. || B. Finally, put the second slice on top, cut it in half, and enjoy your snack. || C. Take two fresh slices of bread and spread a thick layer of butter on one of them. || D. Sprinkle a pinch of salt and pepper for some extra flavor.
explanation: C pehla step hai (bread lena aur butter lagana). A mein butter ke upar tomatoes aur cucumbers rakhne hain. D mein salt aur pepper sprinkle karna hai. B last step hai (dusri slice rakhna aur cut karna).
trick: Veggies (A) rakhne ke baad hi uske upar salt/pepper (D) dalenge. Toh A -> D ek solid sequence hai.
tip: Recipe hamesha base se shuru hokar topping par khatam hoti hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Tommy, his loyal dog, instantly ran after it with great excitement. || B. Every evening, Mr. Sharma takes his dog to the park for some exercise. || C. He picked up a wooden stick and threw it as far as he could. || D. Tommy fetched the stick and happily dropped it at his master's feet.
explanation: B intro hai jo unke daily routine ko batata hai. C mein Mr. Sharma stick phenkte hain. A mein Tommy us stick ke peeche bhagta hai. D mein Tommy stick wapas lakar deta hai (fetched).
trick: Stick phenkna (C) pehle hoga, uske baad Tommy bhagega (A). Isliye C -> A hamesha ek sath rahenge.
tip: 'It' (A) refer karta hai 'stick' (C) ko.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He dug a small hole in his garden and gently placed the seed inside. || B. Ravi wanted to grow a mango tree in his backyard. || C. After a few weeks of watering, a tiny green shoot finally popped out of the soil. || D. He covered the seed with soft soil and poured some water over it.
explanation: B intro hai (Ravi ka sapna). A mein usne hole dig kiya aur seed daala. D mein seed ko soil se cover kiya aur pani diya. C result hai jahan kuch hafte baad shoot (paudha) nikalta hai.
trick: Hole dig karke seed dalna (A) sabse pehla physical action hai. Seed cover karna (D) uske turant baad ka step hai.
tip: Physical process ka chronological order hamesha fix hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Suddenly, the power went off, plunging the whole room into total darkness. || B. Anjali was studying hard for her final mathematics exam late at night. || C. She quickly grabbed her phone, turned on the flashlight, and lit a candle. || D. With the candle burning brightly, she peacefully resumed her studies.
explanation: B context set karta hai (Anjali studying late at night). A problem lata hai (power went off). C us problem ka immediate solution hai (lit a candle). D final situation hai (resumed studies).
trick: Light jana (A) ek problem hai, aur candle jalana (C) uska solution hai. A ke baad hi C aayega.
tip: Problem aur Solution approach use karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. When she opened the door, everyone jumped out and shouted, 'Surprise!' || B. We decorated the living room with balloons and hid behind the sofa. || C. Today was my sister's birthday, and we planned a surprise party for her. || D. She was so happy and touched that she hugged all of us with tears of joy.
explanation: C main idea hai (surprise party plan). B us plan ka execution hai (decoration and hiding). A mein sister door open karti hai aur surprise milti hai. D uska reaction hai (happy and hugged).
trick: Chhupna (B) door open hone (A) se pehle hoga. Aur khushi ka reaction (D) sabse last mein aayega.
tip: Event preparation hamesha event ke pehle aati hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. A huge, magical genie appeared and offered to grant him three wishes. || B. Aladdin was exploring an old, dusty cave when he found a strange lamp. || C. He took it home and started rubbing it with a cloth to clean the dust. || D. Shocked but happy, Aladdin immediately asked for a grand feast as his first wish.
explanation: B intro hai jahan Aladdin ko lamp milta hai. C mein wo lamp ko saaf karta hai (rubbing it). A mein genie bahar aata hai. D mein Aladdin apni pehli wish maangta hai.
trick: Lamp rub karne (C) ke baad hi Genie aayega (A). C -> A ek clear sequence banata hai.
tip: Cause (Rubbing) aur Effect (Genie appearing) check karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The cunning fox flattered her by praising her sweet voice. || B. A hungry fox saw a crow sitting on a branch with a piece of cheese. || C. As soon as the crow opened her beak to sing, the cheese fell down. || D. He quickly grabbed the fallen cheese and ran away into the forest.
explanation: B pehla sentence hoga kyunki yeh main characters (fox aur crow) ko introduce kar raha hai. A mein fox trick use karta hai (flattery). C mein crow gaana gaati hai aur cheese gir jata hai. D mein fox cheese lekar bhaag jata hai jo story ka end hai.
trick: Sentence B mein noun 'fox' hai aur D mein pronoun 'He' hai. Iska matlab D humesha B ke baad aayega.
tip: Story ka shuruwati sentence hamesha independent hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. We reached the cinema hall just in time for the opening scene. || B. My friends and I decided to watch a newly released action movie. || C. During the interval, we bought some popcorn and cold drinks. || D. After booking the tickets online, we booked a cab to the mall.
explanation: B plan bata raha hai, toh yeh first hoga. D mein tickets book karke cab li. A mein cinema hall pahuche. C interval ka scene hai jo hamesha movie start hone ke baad (A ke baad) aayega.
trick: Interval (C) hamesha movie shuru hone (A) ke baad hi aayega. Toh A -> C mandatory pair ban gaya.
tip: Real-life events ko chronological order mein set karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He was so happy that he started touching everything in his palace. || B. King Midas was granted a wish that whatever he touched would turn into gold. || C. But his joy vanished when he accidentally turned his own daughter into a golden statue. || D. The tables, chairs, and even the pillars instantly turned into solid gold.
explanation: B pehla sentence hai jahan King Midas aur uski wish ko introduce kiya gaya hai. A uski khushi aur action dikhata hai. D uske action ka result (cheezein gold ban gayi) batata hai. C climax hai jahan uski beti statue ban jaati hai.
trick: 'But' se shuru hone wala sentence (C) hamesha kisi positive cheez (A aur D) ka contrast hota hai, isliye yeh end mein aayega.
tip: Contrast words jaise 'But' end ya middle mein aate hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He realized that the front tire of his bicycle was completely flat. || B. Rahul was getting ready to ride his bicycle to the park. || C. He took out his air pump and filled the tire with air. || D. After checking the pressure, he happily rode away to meet his friends.
explanation: B context set karta hai (Rahul getting ready). A mein usko problem dikhti hai (flat tire). C uska solution hai (air pump use karna). D final result hai jahan woh park nikal jata hai.
trick: Problem (A) aane ke baad hi solution (C) nikala jayega. A -> C ek perfect pair hai.
tip: Problem aur Solution ka link humesha dhyan mein rakhein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. They met in the middle of the bridge and neither wanted to step back. || B. Two foolish goats were trying to cross a narrow wooden bridge from opposite sides. || C. As a result, both of them lost their balance and fell into the deep river. || D. Instead of compromising, they started fighting with their horns.
explanation: B intro hai (do goats bridge cross kar rahi hain). A mein woh middle mein milti hain. D mein unka jhagda shuru hota hai. C unke jhagde ka final result hai (nadi mein girna).
trick: 'As a result' (C) clearly bata raha hai ki yeh kisi action ka final outcome hai, isliye yeh last mein aayega.
tip: Outcome batane wale words hamesha paragraph end karte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Next, she poured the smooth batter into a greased baking pan. || B. First, Reema gathered flour, sugar, eggs, and butter in a large bowl. || C. Finally, she took the freshly baked cake out and let it cool. || D. She then placed the pan inside the preheated oven for thirty minutes.
explanation: Yeh baking ka process hai. B pehla step hai ('First'). A doosra step hai ('Next'). D teesra step hai jisme pan oven mein rakha gaya ('then'). C aakhri step hai ('Finally').
trick: Sequence words jaise 'First', 'Next', 'then', aur 'Finally' directly bata dete hain ki order B -> A -> D -> C hoga.
tip: Transition words hamesha chronological order set karte hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The villagers came running to help, but found no wolf and scolded him. || B. A naughty shepherd boy used to take his sheep to graze on a hill. || C. One day, a real wolf attacked, but nobody came when he cried for help. || D. Just for fun, he would loudly shout that a wolf was attacking his flock.
explanation: B intro hai (shepherd boy ki habit). D uski daily shararat batata hai. A gaon walon ka reaction hai jab wo jhooth bolta tha. C climax hai jab sach mein wolf aata hai aur koi nahi aata.
trick: Jhooth bolne wala incident (D, A) hamesha sach mein wolf aane wale incident (C) se pehle hoga.
tip: Story ke events ka cause aur effect samjhein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He rushed to the examination hall, panting and sweating. || B. Mohit woke up late on the day of his final board exam. || C. Fortunately, he was allowed to enter just five minutes before the bell rang. || D. He quickly skipped his breakfast and ran towards the bus stop.
explanation: B problem batata hai ki Mohit late utha. D mein wo jaldi nikalta hai (breakfast skip kiya). A mein wo exam hall pahuchta hai. C mein usko lucky entry mil jati hai jo final event hai.
trick: Bus stop (D) jana exam hall (A) pahuchne se pehle hoga. Isliye D hamesha A se pehle aayega.
tip: Travel sequence pehle origin fir destination dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. A friendly dove sitting on a nearby tree saw the ant drowning. || B. An ant went to a river to drink water but slipped and fell in. || C. The ant quickly climbed onto the leaf and safely reached the bank. || D. She plucked a broad leaf and dropped it near the struggling ant.
explanation: B opening sentence hai jahan ant pani mein girti hai. A mein dove usko dekhti hai. D mein dove uski help karne ke liye patta daalti hai. C mein ant patte par baithkar bach jati hai.
trick: Dove pehle ant ko dekhegi (A) uske baad hi patta fenkegi (D). A -> D mandatory pair hai.
tip: Actions ka logical order hamesha follow hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. I picked some fresh tomatoes, potatoes, and green leafy vegetables. || B. My mother asked me to go to the local market to buy some groceries. || C. After paying the vendor, I carefully placed everything in my cloth bag. || D. I took out my bicycle and reached the crowded vegetable market.
explanation: B instruction hai market jaane ka. D mein wo cycle se market pahuchta hai. A mein wo vegetables select karta hai. C mein bill pay karke bag mein rakhta hai.
trick: Market pahuchne (D) ke baad hi sabzi kharidna (A) shuru hoga. B -> D -> A ek clear sequence hai.
tip: Instruction pehle aata hai, execution baad mein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Then, they laid a strong foundation using bricks and cement. || B. Finally, the walls were painted and the family moved into their new home. || C. The workers first cleared the empty plot of land and leveled the ground. || D. Mr. Sharma hired an experienced architect to design his dream house.
explanation: D mein house banane ka plan aur architect hire karne ki baat hai. C pehla physical step hai (plot clear karna). A doosra step hai (foundation banana). B aakhri step hai (ghar shift hona).
trick: 'Finally' (B) sentence hamesha last mein aayega. Options check karein jisme B end mein ho.
tip: Planning hamesha execution se pehle aati hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The old woman gave her a magic pot that cooked sweet porridge on command. || B. A poor little girl went into the forest searching for food. || C. She took the pot home and her mother started cooking porridge every day. || D. There, she met a kind old woman who felt pity for her hunger.
explanation: B intro hai (girl forest gayi). D mein wo old woman se milti hai ('There' word forest ke liye hai). A mein old woman usko magic pot deti hai. C mein wo pot ghar le aati hai.
trick: 'There' (D) refer kar raha hai 'forest' (B) ko. Isliye D hamesha B ke just baad aayega.
tip: Pronoun aur Adverb of place ko noun se link karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. A few days later, a delivery agent arrived at my doorstep with a package. || B. I opened the box excitedly and found the exact same shoes I had ordered. || C. I added the shoes to my cart and paid using my debit card. || D. While scrolling through a shopping app, I saw a pair of beautiful sneakers.
explanation: D mein shoes pasand aate hain. C mein purchase hoti hai (cart + payment). A mein delivery hoti hai 'A few days later'. B mein unboxing hoti hai.
trick: Payment karna (C) hamesha delivery aane (A) se pehle hoga. Aur unboxing (B) sabse aakhri step hai.
tip: Online shopping ka natural order follow karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The tiger got very angry and promised to take revenge one day. || B. A woodcutter saved a tiger trapped in a cage but called him ungrateful. || C. He realized his mistake and apologized, but the friendship was broken. || D. The woodcutter's harsh words hurt the tiger more than any physical wound.
explanation: B intro hai jisme woodcutter aur tiger ka incident bataya gaya hai. D batata hai ki woodcutter ke words ('ungrateful') ne tiger ko hurt kiya. A tiger ka reaction hai (gussa). C woodcutter ka realization hai.
trick: Woodcutter ne 'ungrateful' bola (B), jisko 'harsh words' (D) refer kar raha hai. Toh B ke baad D aayega.
tip: Keywords ko match karke sentences connect karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The doctor examined me carefully and prescribed some medicines. || B. I was suffering from a severe headache and high fever since last night. || C. I bought the medicines from the pharmacy and returned home to rest. || D. My father immediately booked an appointment and took me to the clinic.
explanation: B problem hai (fever/headache). D action hai (appointment aur clinic jana). A doctor ka kaam hai (examination aur prescription). C final result hai jahan medicine lekar rest kiya.
trick: Doctor dawai likhega (A) tabhi aap pharmacy se kharid paoge (C). A -> C mandatory sequence hai.
tip: Logically sochkar process complete karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He barked at his own reflection to snatch the other piece of meat. || B. A dog stole a piece of meat from a butcher's shop and ran away. || C. While crossing a stream, he looked down and saw his own reflection. || D. In doing so, his own piece of meat fell into the deep water and was lost.
explanation: B intro hai jisme dog meat churata hai. C mein wo bridge cross karte hue paani mein dekhta hai. A mein wo doosre 'dog' (reflection) par bhonkta hai. D mein uska khud ka meat gir jata hai.
trick: Pani mein dekhega (C) tabhi bhonkega (A). 'In doing so' (D) bark karne ke action (A) ko point karta hai.
tip: Action aur consequence clearly match hone chahiye.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. After the security check, I waited in the lounge for the boarding announcement. || B. I reached the airport two hours before my scheduled flight to Mumbai. || C. I showed my ticket at the entrance and proceeded to the baggage drop counter. || D. Finally, I boarded the plane and found my window seat.
explanation: B journey ki shuruwat hai (airport pahuchna). C pehla step hai (entrance ticket check aur baggage drop). A next step hai (security check aur waiting). D aakhri step hai (boarding).
trick: 'Finally' (D) hamesha end mein aayega. Baggage drop (C) security check (A) se pehle hota hai.
tip: Airport rules jaisa logical flow identify karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He accidentally dropped his iron axe into a deep river while chopping wood. || B. A poor but honest woodcutter used to cut trees in the forest. || C. The god was pleased with his honesty and gave him all three axes. || D. The River God appeared and offered him a golden axe, but he refused it.
explanation: B intro hai (honest woodcutter). A uske sath hua accident hai (kulhadi girna). D bhagwan ka aana aur golden axe offer karna hai. C final outcome hai jahan usko teeno axes milti hain.
trick: Axe giregi (A) tabhi River God aayenge (D). Bhagwan pehle test karenge (D) fir khush honge (C).
tip: Cause, Action, Reaction aur Reward ka order yaad rakhein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Suddenly, a loud thunder struck and the electricity went off. || B. It was raining heavily on a dark Sunday evening. || C. My mother lit a few candles and we sat together playing board games. || D. I was sitting in my room, trying to finish my pending homework.
explanation: B weather aur background set kar raha hai. D current situation batata hai ki main kya kar raha tha. A problem introduce karta hai (electricity chali gayi). C problem ka solution aur final activity batata hai.
trick: Light jane (A) ke baad hi candles jalayi jayengi (C). A -> C mandatory pair hai.
tip: Setting pehle aati hai, fir event start hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He then tied them into a bundle and asked them to break it, but they failed. || B. An old farmer was sad because his sons were always fighting with each other. || C. He gave them each a single stick, which they broke very easily. || D. This taught them the valuable lesson that unity is strength.
explanation: B intro hai ki kisan pareshan tha. C mein usne pehla task diya (single stick todne ka). A mein usne bundle todne ko bola. D moral of the story hai jo hamesha end mein aata hai.
trick: Single stick tutegi (C) aur fir bundle nahi tutega (A). Aur 'This taught them' (D) clearly conclusion hai.
tip: Moral lessons hamesha aakhri sentence hote hain.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. He went to the nearest bookstore and asked the shopkeeper for it. || B. Rohan wanted to read a new science fiction novel. || C. Finally, he paid the bill and happily started reading on his way back. || D. The shopkeeper handed him the latest edition of the book.
explanation: B pehla sentence hai kyunki yeh Rohan aur uski need (novel) ko introduce kar raha hai. A mein woh bookstore gaya novel lene. D mein shopkeeper ne usko book di. C mein usne bill pay kiya aur wapas aaya, jo final action hai.
trick: Noun 'Rohan' sentence B mein hai aur baaki mein pronoun 'He' hai. Isliye B sabse pehle aayega. Aur bill pay karna (C) hamesha last mein hota hai.
tip: Shopping ka logical step: Jaana -> Maangna -> Milna -> Pay karna.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Add two spoons of sugar and a pinch of salt to it. || B. First, squeeze the juice of half a lemon into a glass of water. || C. Stir the mixture well until the sugar is completely dissolved. || D. To make a refreshing glass of lemonade, follow these simple steps.
explanation: D opening sentence hai kyunki yeh ek process (lemonade making) ko introduce kar raha hai. B pehla step hai ('First' use hua hai). A doosra step hai jisme sugar aur salt add kiye gaye. C last step hai jisme mix kiya gaya.
trick: Sentence D mein 'follow these simple steps' likha hai, toh saare steps (B, A, C) D ke baad hi aayenge.
tip: Process ko introduce karne wala sentence hamesha first hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The stork could not drink the soup with its long beak and remained hungry. || B. A cunning fox once invited his friend, the stork, for dinner. || C. To teach him a lesson, the stork later invited the fox and served food in a tall, narrow jar. || D. He deliberately served delicious hot soup in a very shallow dish.
explanation: B intro hai jahan fox stork ko invite karta hai. D mein fox ne shallow dish (kam gahri plate) mein soup serve kiya. A mein stork apni long beak ki wajah se soup nahi pi paaya. C climax hai jahan stork revenge leta hai.
trick: Sentence A mein result bataya hai ki stork bhookha reh gaya. Yeh tabhi hoga jab fox dish serve karega (D). Toh D ke baad A aayega.
tip: Story ka action aur reaction link karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. Add a scoop of detergent powder into the designated drawer. || B. First, sort your laundry into light and dark colors. || C. Finally, select the wash cycle and press the start button. || D. Put the sorted dirty clothes inside the washing machine drum.
explanation: Yeh washing machine use karne ka process hai. B pehla step hai ('First' sort). D doosra step hai jahan kapde drum mein dale. A teesra step hai detergent dalna. C aakhri step hai ('Finally' press start).
trick: Kapde sort karna (B) hamesha unhe machine mein dalne (D) se pehle hoga. Aur 'Finally' (C) hamesha aakhri sentence hota hai.
tip: Transition words jaise 'First' aur 'Finally' par dhyan dein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The lion looked inside, saw his own reflection, and roared in anger. || B. A cruel lion used to kill many animals in the jungle every day. || C. The clever rabbit led him to a deep well, saying another lion lived there. || D. Thinking it was another lion, he jumped in to attack and drowned.
explanation: B main sentence hai jo lion ke baare mein batata hai. C mein rabbit ek trick play karta hai aur lion ko well tak le jata hai. A mein lion well ke andar dekhta hai aur reflection par roar karta hai. D mein wo jump karke doob jata hai.
trick: Well mein dekhne (A) ke baad hi wo sochega ki doosra lion hai aur jump karega (D). Isliye A -> D ek mandatory pair hai.
tip: Cause (dekhna) aur Action (jump karna) ko connect karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. I quickly brushed my teeth and ran towards the bus stop. || B. My alarm did not ring, and I woke up an hour late. || C. Unfortunately, I saw the bus driving away just as I reached. || D. I had to walk back home and ask my father to drop me at school.
explanation: B root cause hai (alarm nahi baja, late utha). A us late uthne ka reaction hai (jaldi brush karke bhaga). C mein wo bus stop pahucha par bus nikal gayi. D final result hai jahan use papa se help leni padi.
trick: Bus stop pahuchna (C) bhagne (A) ke baad hi hoga. Aur bus miss hone ke baad hi ghar wapas aayega (D).
tip: Ghatnaon (events) ke sequence ko real life ki tarah arrange karein.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. One young mouse suggested tying a bell around the cat's neck to hear her coming. || B. The mice held a meeting to find a way to escape their common enemy, the cat. || C. Everyone cheered until an old mouse asked who would risk their life to tie the bell. || D. They realized that making a plan was much easier than executing it.
explanation: B context set karta hai ki chooho ne meeting bulayi. A mein ek young mouse ne suggestion diya (tying a bell). C mein old mouse ne practical problem batai. D story ka moral hai ki plan banana easy hai, execute karna nahi.
trick: Suggestion (A) dene ke baad hi koi us par question uthayega (C). A -> C mandatory pair ban jata hai.
tip: Discussion wale questions mein Idea fir Objection ka pattern hota hai.

question: Direction: Rearrange the following sentences (A, B, C, D) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. || A. The librarian stamped the due date and handed the book to him. || B.
